jobs.title: Highways Engineer
jobs.description:
Waterman Infrastructure \& Environment Ltd is seeking a motivated and technically capable Highways \& Infrastructure Engineer to join our growing Civil Engineering and Transportation team. The successful candidate will support the delivery of highways, infrastructure, drainage and development engineering projects across a diverse range of sectors including residential, commercial, industrial, logistics, energy, regeneration and major infrastructure developments.


Working within Waterman's multidisciplinary consultancy environment, you will collaborate with transport planners, environmental specialists, flood risk consultants, structural engineers and project managers to develop innovative, sustainable and buildable engineering solutions. The role offers excellent opportunities for technical development, professional progression and support towards Chartered Engineer status. Waterman is committed to delivering innovative engineering and environmental consultancy services with a strong focus on sustainability, collaboration and achieving net zero outcomes.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Highway Design \& Infrastructure Engineering**


* Prepare preliminary and detailed highway designs for residential, commercial and infrastructure developments.
* Design highway alignments, junction improvements, access roads, roundabouts and active travel infrastructure.
* Undertake pavement design and coordinate highway construction specifications.
* Develop Section 38, Section 278 and private road designs.
* Prepare design drawings, reports and technical documentation using industry\-standard software.
* Assist in the preparation of technical approval submissions and responses to authority comments.
* Support the production of feasibility studies, concept designs and infrastructure strategies.

**Drainage \& Utilities**


* Assist in the preparation of drainage strategies and detailed drainage designs.
* Design Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS) in accordance with current standards and best practice.
* Coordinate drainage, utility and highway designs to achieve integrated engineering solutions.
* Undertake hydraulic calculations and contribute to flood risk mitigation measures where appropriate.
* Liaise with utility providers and statutory undertakers regarding infrastructure requirements.

**Project Delivery**


* Deliver technical outputs to agreed programmes, budgets and quality standards.
* Assist with project management activities including programming, resourcing and commercial reporting.
* Coordinate with internal multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Participate in design reviews and quality assurance processes.
* Attend project meetings, site visits and client workshops.

**Client \& Stakeholder Liaison**


* Develop strong working relationships with clients, local authorities and project stakeholders.
* Support discussions with:
* Local Highway Authorities
* National Highways
* Planning Authorities
* Developers
* Contractors
* Utility Providers
* Assist with public consultation and technical approval processes where required.
* Present technical information clearly and professionally.
* Business Development \& Continuous Improvement
* Support bid submissions, fee proposals and framework opportunities.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and technical innovation across the business.
* Promote Waterman's sustainability objectives and low\-carbon design approach.
* Participate in professional development activities and work towards Chartership where applicable.

**Skills \& Experience**


**Essential**


* Degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline.
* Experience within a UK engineering consultancy or contractor environment.
* Understanding of highway and infrastructure design principles.
* Knowledge of UK design standards and guidance.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.

**Desirable**


* Experience using AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
* Experience of Causeway Flow, MicroDrainage or InfoDrainage.

**Knowledge of:**


* DMRB
* Manual for Streets
* Local Authority design guidance
* CDM Regulations
* SuDS standards and surface water management
* Experience preparing Section 38 and Section 278 submissions.
* Progress towards ICE or CIHT professional qualification.

**Personal Attributes**


* Enthusiastic and proactive approach to engineering.
* Strong organisational and time\-management skills.
* Commercial awareness and client\-focused mindset.
* Commitment to quality, innovation and sustainability.
* Desire to learn and develop professionally.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines effectively.

  
**About us**
------------


At Waterman we are committed to our people, our communities, and the planet. We are transforming our business and offering our most exciting opportunities yet so now is the time to join us.  

  



We are a Disability Confident organisation, committed to an active Inclusion, Diversity and Equal Opportunities Policy starting with our recruitment and selection process.


Submit your online application, you will receive an automated confirmation email immediately, so you have the comfort of knowing it has been received. If your application is progressed to the first stage you can expect to hear from a member of our dedicated recruitment team.


If successful, an interview will be arranged at a time convenient for both you and our hiring manager, the initial conversation may be via Teams but we are, of course, keen for you to visit our offices, meet the team and therefore, we’d love to meet you face\-to\-face for a follow up conversation. Good luck, we look forward to welcoming you to the Waterman family!

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
**Field Service Engineer \- Telehandler \& Roto Hire Specialist \| East Midlands**

**Package:** £38,000 \+ Vehicle \+ Overtime \+ 25 Days Annual Leave \+ Extensive Benefits Package

**Location:** East Midlands \- field\-based, covering customer sites across the region

**Type:** Full\-time, permanent (40 hours per week \- Door to Door)

**The Opportunity**

Plenty of field service roles have you chasing whatever lands in the van that day \- a different make every visit, no manufacturer support, and a parts department that sees you as a nuisance. This one is different.

Our client is the specialist telehandler and roto hire division of one of the UK’s best\-known equipment rental groups. They do one thing \- telehandlers and rotating telehandlers \- and they do it properly. Their engineers are trained by the biggest manufacturers in the industry, their service vans are profiled for telehandlers and rotos only, and they fully service and maintain their own fleet on site rather than leaning on the manufacturers to do it for them.

They’re looking for a skilled Field Service Engineer to look after their machines and customers across the East Midlands. If you’re an experienced plant or agricultural fitter who wants to specialise, get manufacturer\-level training on the latest kit, and work for a business that openly says it invests heavily in its field engineers, this is well worth a conversation.

**About the Company**

Our client is a nationally recognised specialist in telehandler and roto hire, part of a listed specialist equipment rental group whose heritage goes back to 1954 and which celebrated its 70th anniversary in 2024\. The group turns over more than £350 million a year across a portfolio of specialist rental businesses serving infrastructure, construction, housebuilding, utilities and energy.

The division runs what it describes as the most diverse telehandler and roto fleet in the UK \- from compact 4m telehandlers right up to 35m rotating machines, alongside 7\.2 and 12 tonne heavy lift telehandlers, electric telehandlers and Teletruks. The fleet is built around the leading manufacturers, including JCB, Manitou and Merlo, so you’ll be working on modern, well\-maintained machines rather than tired kit that’s been run into the ground.

A depot network stretching from Aberdeen to Penzance means there’s nowhere in the UK they can’t reach, and a centralised hire and service desk handles enquiries nationwide \- giving engineers in the field real technical back\-up over the phone when they need it. Customers range from national housebuilders and main contractors to infrastructure and utilities clients, and many have been working with the business for years.

Safety is taken seriously too. The group’s approach is built around getting everyone home safe and healthy, with third\-party validation of how it manages risk, and it has had its net\-zero targets validated by the Science Based Targets initiative \- so you’ll see more electric and low\-emission machines coming through the fleet.

**The Role**

As Field Service Engineer, you’ll be the face of the business on customer sites across the East Midlands \- keeping hire machines working, getting broken\-down machines back to work quickly, and making sure customers want to hire again.

You’ll plan and manage your own workload, work closely with the service desk and wider operations team, and take ownership of the machines and customers on your patch. Expect a mix of planned servicing, breakdowns and fault\-finding across construction, housebuilding, infrastructure and utilities sites.

What you’ll be doing:

* Carrying out planned maintenance and servicing on hire telehandlers and rotos on customer sites
* Responding to breakdowns and delivering fast, effective repairs to keep customer downtime to a minimum
* Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hydraulic and electrical faults on site
* Acting as the frontline representative for the business, building strong, lasting relationships with customers
* Working with the service desk and wider operations teams to spot and deliver improvements to the service
* Keeping accurate records of every repair, service and customer interaction
* Managing your own diary and time effectively across a busy regional patch

**About You**

* Proven experience repairing and servicing plant equipment, including telehandlers \- essential
* A recognised mechanical qualification in plant or agricultural engineering (NVQ, City \& Guilds or equivalent) \- desirable
* Experience with rotating telehandlers, heavy lift machines or electric telehandlers is a bonus, but full training is provided
* A practical problem\-solver who uses their initiative and is confident working on their own
* A good communicator with a genuine customer service mindset
* Well organised, with experience of managing your own time and workload
* Happy to travel to customer sites across the region as required
* A valid UK driving licence

**What’s On Offer**

* Competitive salary
* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, with the option to buy additional holiday
* Salary sacrifice pension
* Life assurance at 3x salary
* Share save scheme \- a real stake in the business you help grow
* Manufacturer\-led training on the latest telehandler and roto technology, plus structured in\-house and external training
* Access to the group’s online learning Academy for ongoing development
* Free tool hire from across the group
* Health cash plan at discounted premiums, eye care vouchers and gym discounts
* 24/7 accident helpline, cycle to work scheme and long service recognition
* Employee discount platform with savings at thousands of well\-known brands, plus discounts on HP products and EE mobile contracts
* Recommend a friend scheme
* The security of a long\-established, nationally recognised group, with genuine career progression across its specialist businesses

**How to Apply**

If you’re an experienced plant or telehandler engineer looking to specialise with a business that invests in its engineers and backs them properly in the field, we’d like to hear from you. Apply through Rommbic with your CV, or get in touch with us for a confidential conversation about the role.

Pay: £35,000\.00\-£38,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Additional leave
* Company car
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Health \& wellbeing programme

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Vacancy Number: 29069
Category: Engineering \- Project Management
Job Type: Full\-time  

Are you looking for a new challenge?

  

Join our dedicated team in Networks Projects, we manage the delivery of major projects including design services and pre\-capital allocation deliverables to the Networks business. Networks Projects supports Network Assets in the development of project scope and costs based on Technical Approvals (TAs) or Committed Project Parameters (CPPs).

  

Networks Project Development concentrate on developing the scope to approval which involves working closely with the Centre of Engineering (CoE) and ESB Networks along with supporting the Technical Costing Unit (TCU) in developing project costs for Capital Approval (CA). This group is responsible for collating the technical input to the scope along with reviewing potential options and agreeing these with the Owners Engineer (OE) within Networks Assets (NA).

  

We have a permanent position for a Project Development Engineer to join the Project Development Team to deliver the processes and systems required to meet ESBN’s Capital Approval process.

  

**Key Responsibilities**


The Project Development Engineer will assist Project Development team members in all aspects of the project conception including; technical scoping, technical costing, commercial, design, project programming, development and interfacing with clients.


The role will also include some/all the following work:

  

* Owning the end project deliverables during the Project Development phase, in particular business case success measures including time, cost, scope \& quality whilst shadowing the PSDP for this phase of the project.
* Developing the Project Brief as set out by Network Assets and/or EirGrid into a viable Project Management Plan ready to transition from Project Development to Project Delivery stage.
* Delivering for approval the Scope of Works, Project Costs and Project Management Plans to agreed target timelines.
* For EPC and D\&B projects, aid the development of the In \& Out Of Scope, Interface Schedule and other relevant documents, in conjunction with the Project Delivery team and support the procurement process for the project.
Manage the overall project deliverables for all stakeholders, coordinating inputs with the relevant stakeholders at project development stage.  
* 

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**


**Essential**

* A minimum of three years’ experience in substation design.
* A good understanding of all elements of substation scoping, planning, design, costing, construction and commissioning.
* A strong work ethic with a clear focus on delivery to EMPs safety, time, quality and cost objectives.
* Good commercial and project management understanding.
* The demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent communication and report writing skills.
* A willingness to improve understanding of technical aspects related to substation design and interest in personal development.
* A flexible approach to work, especially where necessary to meet agreed KPIs.
  

**Desirable**


Full drivers' licence and relevant competencies to visit ESBN substations and sites on their own.  

* 

**Qualifications**


**Essential**


* Third level qualification or appropriate experience
  

**Desirable**


It is preferred that the candidate has achieved the following:


* PSDP Competency or CDMC equivalent.
* Site Working Competencies.
  

**Location**


This role is based in either of EMP'S offices in OneDac, Dublin Airport or Little Island, Cork but travel to project locations as required is a key requirement of the role.

  

ESB is committed to smart working – combining digital tools with a culture of trust and empowerment to enable flexible ways of working. The successful candidate may work flexibly within their jurisdiction with attendance at the workplace for in\-person collaboration on at least one anchor day per week. All smart working arrangements are subject to manager approval and ongoing review, based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the individual.

  

**Why ESB?**


* Opportunity to lead and operate on frontline of Ireland’s transition to net zero future
* Embracing \& facilitating a Smart Working Future / Hybrid Working
* Career development through mentoring, and training
* Corporate Social Responsibility Opportunities
* Active Social \& Sports Clubs
* Networking opportunities
* Credit Union
* Generous Pension Contributions
* Access to Staff Well Being programmes
* Generous parents leave entitlements
* Great team environment working to our Core Values – Courageous, Caring, Driven and Trusted
* ESB has a comprehensive Diversity and Inclusion Programme
  

**Reporting to**


Reporting to the Senior Team Leader within Networks Projects Development

  

**Salary**


€49,000 to €58,000 per annum

  

**Closing Date**


5th October 2026

  

**Interview**


Candidates who are shortlisted for interview will complete a Behavioural Interview based on each of the following Behaviours, which underpin how we work at ESB and are critical to delivering our strategy:

  

* Accountable and Ethical
* Collaborative
* Growing and Adaptive
* Proactive
* Respectful and Supportive
  

More information available on Our People Promise

  

**Notes**


Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.

  

The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.


**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement**


ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.


Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.


**About ESB**


Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero\-carbon electricity.

jobs.title: Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Developer (m/w/d) – Mannheim - Jobbird.com
jobs.description:
Als Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Developer (m/w/d) entwickelst du kundenindividuelle Lösungen mit C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript und sorgst dafür, dass aus fachlichen Anforderungen saubere, nachhaltige technische Lösungen entstehen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kunden und Projektteams zusammen und bringst dein Senior-Know-how aktiv in unsere Projekte und unser Team ein.

Tätigkeiten

Microsoft Dynamics 365 (CRM): Du berätst unsere Kunden bei anspruchsvollen CRM-Projekten, analysierst ihre Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales / Customer Service / Marketing / Field Service).
Lösungsdesign & Entwicklung: Du konzipierst und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen mit C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript und legst dabei großen Wert auf sauberen Code, Qualität und Wartbarkeit.
Anforderungen technisch übersetzen: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und Consultants zusammen, verstehst fachliche Anforderungen und überführst sie in durchdachte technische Konzepte.
Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Du bewertest Lösungswege, unterstützt bei der Priorisierung technischer Themen und sorgst dafür, dass Projekte strukturiert und zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.
Wissen weitergeben: Du teilst deine Erfahrung im Team, unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei komplexen Fragestellungen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer technischen Standards ein.
Workshops & Kundentermine: Du bringst deine technische Expertise in Workshops, Präsentationen und Pitch-Terminen ein und hilfst so dabei, Kunden von unseren Lösungen zu überzeugen und neue Projekte zu gewinnen.

Anforderungen

Ausbildung: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (B.Sc. / M.Sc.) mit dem Schwerpunkt (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine Ausbildung mit vergleichbarer Qualifikation. Wichtiger als dein schulischer Werdegang ist uns aber, dass du fachlich stark bist und Verantwortung übernehmen willst.
Erfahrung: Du hast bereits mehrere Beratungs- und Umsetzungsprojekte im CRM-/Business-Software-Umfeld erfolgreich begleitet und fühlst dich besonders in der technischen Konzeption und Umsetzung sicher. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder vergleichbaren Plattformen mit. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von Teams oder Projekten ist wünschenswert; disziplinarische Führungserfahrung ist ein zusätzliches Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Technisches Know-how: C#/.NET sowie JavaScript/TypeScript gehören zu deinem Werkzeugkasten. Du legst Wert auf sauberen, wartbaren Code und entwickelst Lösungen mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit.
Persönlichkeit: Du denkst strukturiert, kommunizierst offen und direkt und kannst fachliche Anforderungen in durchdachte technische Lösungen übersetzen. Die Kombination aus technischer Tiefe, Eigeninitiative und direktem Kundenkontakt passt perfekt zu dir.
Begeisterung: Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, fachlich vorangehen und dein Wissen nicht nur in Projekte, sondern auch in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Teams einbringen.
Kommunikation: Dein Profil wird abgerundet durch sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie ein souveränes Auftreten in Workshops, Kundenterminen und Pitch-Terminen.

Team

Warum wir?

Technische Verantwortung mit echtem Einfluss: Du bringst dein Know-how aktiv in unsere Projekte und die Weiterentwicklung des Teams ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für technische Lösungen und unterstützt andere bei komplexen Fragestellungen.
Qualität statt Standardlösungen: Dich erwarten vielseitige CRM-Projekte, in denen du saubere, wartbare und nachhaltige Lösungen entwickelst – mit dem Anspruch, nicht nur funktionierenden, sondern wirklich guten Code zu schreiben.
Echte Wertschätzung: Wenn du Teil unseres Teams wirst, dann haben wir dich auserwählt. Das heißt, dass uns deine Leistungen, dein Wohlergehen sowie deine Meinung sehr viel bedeuten – und das zeigen wir auch.
Deine Weiterentwicklung ist unser Erfolg: Daher gibt es regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, die dein Verbesserungspotenzial auslegen. Hast du Interesse an einer Weiterbildung oder einem Kurs, der dich begeistert und deine Fähigkeiten stärkt? Sprich uns gerne an – wir sind immer offen für deine Ideen!
Mitgestaltung ausdrücklich erwünscht: Deine Ideen zu Architektur, Prozessen, Teamaufbau oder Kundenprojekten sind willkommen. Wenn etwas besser geht, hören wir zu.
Perspektive über die Rolle hinaus: Wenn du neben der fachlichen Führung auch Lust auf disziplinarische Verantwortung hast, bieten wir dir auch dafür die passende Entwicklungsperspektive.

Wir sind mutig, wenn es darum geht, für die beste Lösung einzutreten und ehrlich zu unseren Kunden und Kollegen. Du bringst eine stetige Bereitschaft zum Lernen neuer Technologien und Konzepte mit

Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1) für die Arbeit in internationalen Teams und für die Kommunikation mit deutschsprachigen Kunden.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Applications - Ratings Technology (Manchester)
jobs.description:
As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.

Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Applications – Ratings Technology

Fitch Ratings is seeking a Senior Software Engineer
to join our global Ratings Technology team in Manchester
. This is your opportunity to not just build mission-critical applications, but to shape the future direction
of technology that powers how a world-leading credit ratings agency delivers insights. Your leadership, architectural decisions, and vision will directly impact analysts, executives, and decision-makers who shape global financial markets.

You'll work closely with our talented engineering teams supporting Ratings workflow and analytical applications, influencing both technical architecture and organizational direction
. We're looking for a seasoned technologist who thrives on challenging assumptions, experimenting with emerging technologies (especially AI), and pushing boundaries
—not an MLE or AI specialist, but a full-stack engineer who's curious, unafraid to question the status quo, and excited to explore how AI can transform analytical workflows, as well as delivering high quality user experiences in their applications. This is a critical role
for an organization expanding rapidly and building for the future, offering mobility and upward potential for the right visionary.

What We Offer

Strategic leadership with organizational impact – Shape technical architecture and product direction for applications used by analysts worldwide, with high visibility to senior leadership and the ability to influence technology strategy across Ratings Technology
Innovation-first culture and experimentation – Permission to challenge established patterns, explore emerging technologies including AI, and drive proof-of-concepts with access to cutting-edge tools and a community that celebrates curiosity and bold thinking
Continuous learning and career growth – Training, certifications, conferences, mentorship opportunities, and clear paths to principal/architect/leadership tracks as you establish yourself as a thought leader
Flexibility and world-class environment – Work from premier offices in London, Manchester, or Toronto with hybrid flexibility, competitive compensation reflecting your seniority, comprehensive benefits, and a culture that values both innovation and work-life harmony

We'll Count On You To

Deliver technical excellence and build game-changing solutions – Design robust, scalable full-stack applications using Java/Springboot, C#/.NET, Python and REACT, drive architectural decisions, establish technical standards, and lead exploration of AI/ML integration opportunities that transform workflows
Offer influence and mentorship – Partner with product managers, analysts, and senior stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, mentor engineers, facilitate technical discussions, and foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and psychological safety
Challenge the status quo and drive innovation – Question existing approaches, champion better solutions even when uncomfortable, experiment with emerging technologies, create proofs-of-concept, and push the organization toward what's possible rather than what's comfortable
Champion engineering excellence and quality – Implement CI/CD pipelines, conduct architecture reviews, solve complex performance and scalability challenges, establish best practices that scale across teams, and balance innovation with pragmatic delivery
Shape organizational and team direction – Influence team processes, lead strategic technical initiatives spanning multiple teams, bring fresh perspectives while respecting institutional knowledge, and model the curiosity, humility, and boldness needed across the organization
Own reliability and navigate complexity – Provide expert troubleshooting for sophisticated issues, maintain system performance at scale, balance multiple strategic priorities, and deliver excellence in fast-paced Agile environments

What You Need To Have

Deep full-stack engineering expertise – 10+ years of hands-on experience building enterprise applications, with expert-level proficiency in Java/Springboot and/or C#/.NET, good familiarity with Python, REACT and modern web technologies in production environments.
Architectural mastery and technical depth – Proven track record of designing maintainable, scalable systems; excellent understanding of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and the ability to make architectural decisions and live with their consequences
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
Visionary problem-solving and growth mindset – Exceptional analytical abilities, demonstrated curiosity about emerging technologies, track record of experimentation and learning from failures, comfort with ambiguity, and ability to bring your whole self while remaining open to others' perspectives
Outstanding collaboration and communication skills – Proven success with cross-functional teams, ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, and emotional intelligence to navigate organizational dynamics

What Would Make You Stand Out

Modern engineering practices and DevOps prowess – Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and hands-on cloud expertise with microservices and cloud-native architecture
AI curiosity and exploration mindset – Genuine interest in how AI/ML, generative AI, or intelligent automation could transform software delivery, business processes, systems and applications; experience experimenting with new technologies and evaluating practical applications; comfort with emerging technology ambiguity
Financial services domain expertise – Experience with analytical workflows, regulatory processes, financial products, credit ratings, or understanding of how technology enables better decision-making
Agile mastery and change agent experience – Track record of establishing practices, challenging established patterns constructively, and creating space for teams to innovate and take calculated risks

If you are a seasoned technologist with a passion for innovation, a desire to shape organizational direction, and the courage to question the status quo, we would love to hear from you!

Why Choose Fitch

Hybrid Work Environment: 2 to 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning, financial wellness and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
Promoting Health & Wellness: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that prioritize a healthy body & mind
Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-first policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days and support for community engagement initiatives

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you looking to grow your career in software engineering? Join Social Security Scotland and help build digital services that make a real difference to people's lives across Scotland.

As an Associate Software Engineer, you'll work as part of a supportive and collaborative team, contributing to the development, maintenance and improvement of modern digital services. You'll have the opportunity to work with experienced engineers, learn new technologies, and develop your technical skills through hands-on experience, coaching and mentoring.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the early stages of their software engineering career who is keen to learn, solve problems and build high-quality digital solutions. You'll be supported to develop your knowledge across software development, testing, security, user-centred design and modern engineering practices, while gaining valuable experience working within a large public sector organisation.

At Social Security Scotland, continuous learning and professional development are encouraged. You'll have access to training, development opportunities and a clear pathway to progress your career within the Digital Profession. Whether you're building on existing experience or taking the next step in your career, you'll be part of a team that values collaboration, innovation and personal growth.

Together, we deliver digital services that are secure, accessible and user-focused, helping provide vital support to people across Scotland.

An Associate Software Engineer learns on the job by delivering software components.

At This Role Level, You Will

develop skills while working under supervision to deliver stories in a multidisciplinary team
understand and be proficient in different types of testing
be aware of but not responsible for security

Responsibilities

Support the development, testing, maintenance and improvement of software applications, services and infrastructure.
Assist in designing, building and documenting software components, programs and scripts, following established standards and guidance.
Work from user stories and requirements to help deliver solutions that meet user needs and improve user experience.
Contribute to system integration activities, including building and testing interfaces between systems.
Help identify, investigate and resolve software faults and technical issues using agreed processes and procedures.
Support the delivery of secure solutions by following information security requirements and applying security controls.
Assist with maintaining service availability, reliability and performance to ensure systems can meet expected demand.
Use prototyping techniques to explore ideas, test solutions and support development activities.
Collaborate with colleagues and wider project teams to contribute to the design and delivery of larger systems.
Apply modern software engineering standards, tools and practices, with support and guidance from experienced team members.

Success Profiles 

We use an assessment framework called ‘Success Profiles’ which lists the elements we test and provides detailed descriptions of each. Find out more about the framework here.

For this post, the following Success Profile elements will be assessed:

Experience

Experience of contributing to the development of low-complexity software components and working collaboratively as part of a wider team to deliver larger solutions.
Understanding of core Modern JavaScript Framework and/or AEM concepts, with the ability to deliver straightforward development tasks and user stories, seeking feedback and guidance where needed.

Behaviours

Communicating and Influencing (Level 2)
Working Together (Level 2)

You can find out more about Success Profiles Behaviours here:

Technical / Professional Skills

This role is aligned to Junior Developer
within the Government Digital and Data Profession.

Please review the following to understand the skill expectations Software Developer - Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework

These skills will be tested during the Technical Assessment if you are successful at sift stage. They will be not be assessed at application stage.

How To Apply 

Apply online, you must provide a CV and Supporting Statement (of no more than 750 words) which provides evidence of how you meet the Experience and Behaviours listed in the Success Profiles above. 

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools can be used to support your application, but all statements and examples provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, and presented as your own) applications will be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action.

Please see our candidate guidance for more information on acceptable and unacceptable uses of AI in recruitment.

Should a large number of applications be received, an initial sift may be conducted using the CV and Supporting Statement against the first experience criteria. Candidates who pass the initial sift will have their applications fully assessed.

Please note there may be a telephone interview prior to the final interview stage.

Successful candidates will be invited to an interview which will assess the experience and behaviours, and a technical assessment comprising a technical question and answer session to assess the technical skills.

Full details of the interview and assessment process will be shared with shortlisted candidates once the sift has been completed.

We aim to provide feedback on request. However, if we receive a large number of applications it may not be possible for us to provide specific feedback on your application. We will provide feedback on request to candidates who attend an interview/assessment.

Expected Timeline
(subject to change)

Sift - week commencing 5th October 2026

Interview – week commencing 19th October 2026

Location - In Person
in either Dundee or Glasgow

Reserve List  

In the event that there are more successful candidates than posts available, a reserve list will be kept for up to 12 months. 

About Us 

Social Security Scotland is an Executive Agency of the Scottish Government. Our benefits help people from all walks of life in Scotland. We offer rewarding careers and employ people across Scotland in a wide range of professions and roles. We are committed to recruiting a diverse workforce that is representative of the clients we serve.  Find more about us here.  

We offer a supportive and inclusive working environment along with a wide range of employee benefits. Find out more about what we offer. 

As part of the UK Civil Service, we uphold the Civil Service Nationality Rules.   

GDD Pay Supplement

This post is part of the Government Digital and Data (GDD) profession and currently attracts a £6,000 annual GDD pay supplement, which is paid monthly. Pay supplements are reviewed regularly.

Working Pattern

Our standard hours are 35 hours per week and we offer a range of flexible working options, depending on the needs of the role. We embrace a hybrid working style where all colleagues will spend time in either our Glasgow or Dundee offices. There is an expectation of a minimum 2 days per week in your assigned location, which will be either Glasgow or Dundee.  If you have specific questions about the role you are applying for, please contact us. 

Security Checks

Successful candidates must complete the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS), before they can be appointed. BPSS is comprised of four main pre-employment checks – Identity, Right to work, Employment History and a Criminal Record check (unspent convictions).

You can find out more about BPSS on the UK Government website, or read about the different levels of security checks in our Candidate Guide. 

Equality Statement 

Social Security Scotland are committed to equality and inclusion, and we aim to recruit a diverse workforce that reflects the population of our nation.   

Social Security Scotland are a Disability Confident Employer. We will consider and implement any reasonable adjustments you may require throughout the recruitment process and during the course of your employment, should you be successful in securing a post. If you feel you may require assistance with any part of our recruitment process, please contact us at Recruitment@socialsecurity.gov.scot.

Find out more about our commitment to diversity and how we offer and support recruitment adjustments for anyone who needs them.

Right to Work in the UK

Social Security Scotland is an approved sponsor under the UK Visa and Immigration (UKVI) Skilled Worker route. Please note that UK immigration guidance, including skill and salary thresholds and eligible occupations, is reviewed regularly and subject to change. If you require visa sponsorship, you should check the latest criteria to confirm whether this role meets current requirements before applying. You can find further advice at Skilled Worker visa: Overview - GOV.UK

Social Security Scotland’s recruitment processes are underpinned by the recruitment principles of the Civil Service Commissioner, which outline that selection for appointment be made on merit on the basis of fair and open competition - Recruitment - Civil Service Commission.

If you feel at any time your application has not been treated in accordance with the values in the Civil Service Code and/or if you feel the recruitment has been conducted in such a way that conflicts with the Civil Service Commissioner’s Recruitment Principles, you can make a complaint, by contacting Social Security Scotland at recruitment@socialsecurity.gov.scot in the first instance. If you are not satisfied with the response you receive you can contact the Civil Service Commissioner.

The successful candidate will be expected to remain in post for a minimum of 3 years unless successful in gaining promotion to a higher Band or Grade.

Read our Candidate Guide for further information on our recruitment and application processes. 

If you experience any difficulties accessing our website or completing the online application form, please contact the Resourcing Team via recruitment@socialsecurity.gov.scot.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
Deloitte is the world’s number one professional services firm and making an impact is more than what we do. It is why we are here. We bring challenge, curiosity and edge to every project, driving positive progress for our clients, our people, our communities and the planet. This purpose inspires us to work to the highest standards and to tackle the challenges that matter. Number one never stops challenging.

Joining us means becoming part of a Technology and Transformation team that brings challenge, curiosity and edge to every engagement. Working with leading technologies and exceptional people, you will deliver meaningful change for high profile local and international clients. You will help shape the future of digital transformation within a people first culture that is collaborative, innovative and welcoming. At Deloitte, the world’s number one professional services firm, you will tackle complex challenges in an environment where number one never stops challenging.

We offer a competitive starting salary of €91,500.00 for this role, with salary adjustments reflecting your experience level and expertise. .

At Deloitte, our Artificial Intelligence & Data Team drives innovation by helping clients use artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI to solve complex business challenges and unlock measurable value. As an AI Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing and delivering cutting-edge AI solutions across diverse industries, leveraging the latest technologies and our global network.

This role offers a unique opportunity to lead impactful AI-enabled transformation projects, collaborate cross-functionally, and develop your leadership skills in a dynamic, supportive environment focused on continuous learning and personal growth.

Key Skills And Prior Experience

A minimum of a third-level degree in Maths, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related discipline
Proven experience designing and delivering complex artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, or generative AI solutions, with the ability to motivate and guide teams to achieve outstanding results
Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing senior leaders, translating business challenges into practical AI use cases, and providing expert advice based on industry best practices
Commercial experience in AI solution architecture, with familiarity in enterprise-grade AI technologies such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI Service, Databricks Mosaic AI, MLflow, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex, or equivalent platforms
Strong understanding of AI and machine learning solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent assistants, chatbots, recommendation engines, agentic workflows, MLOps, and model deployment
Practical knowledge of responsible AI, including model governance, evaluation, explainability, privacy, security, bias and fairness considerations, and regulatory expectations
Working knowledge of data architecture principles, including how trusted data platforms, data products, APIs, and governance controls support successful AI delivery

What type of work will I be doing?

Scoping, designing, and leading the implementation of scalable AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions using open source, proprietary, and cloud-native technologies
Translating business challenges into practical AI use cases, target architectures, delivery roadmaps, and measurable value cases
Designing AI solution patterns such as assistants, chatbots, retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence, prediction services, recommendation engines, optimisation models, and agentic workflows
Developing technical specifications and architecture designs for AI applications, model pipelines, orchestration layers, knowledge bases, integration patterns, and deployment environments aligned with enterprise standards
Ensuring security, privacy, responsible AI, model governance, monitoring, and evaluation are embedded within all AI architectural designs

jobs.title: Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Rocken Partner entwickelt und fertigt hochpräzise Sensortechnologie für die textile Qualitätskontrolle. Mit innovativen Lösungen zur Garnprüfung und Fehlererkennung zählt das Unternehmen zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich textiler Produktionssysteme. Das Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst die Entwicklung, Fertigung und weltweite Implementierung von Systemen zur automatischen Garnkontrolle. Dabei stehen Präzision, Effizienz und kontinuierliche Innovation im Zentrum – von der Sensortechnologie bis zur vollständigen Prozessoptimierung in Spinnereien und Webereien. Flache Hierarchien und eine technologiegetriebene Arbeitsweise prägen den Alltag. Pioniergeist und Qualitätsanspruch werden hier gelebt, nicht nur versprochen. Bereit, Teil einer Erfolgsgeschichte zu werden, die seit Jahrzehnten Standards setzt? Dann freut sich unser Rocken Partner auf deine Bewerbung.

Verantwortung

Du entwickelst und wartest Desktop- und Webanwendungen inklusive der dazugehörigen CI/CD-Pipelines und Infrastruktur
In dieser Rolle koordinierst du Implementierungs-, Test- und Release-Aktivitäten und arbeitest mit externen Softwarepartnern zusammen
Als Software Engineer arbeitest du eng mit dem Produktmanagement zur Verfeinerung von Spezifikationen und zur Entwicklung neuer Funktionen zusammen
Du stellst den Third-Level-Support für die Softwareprodukte des Unternehmens sicher

Qualifikationen

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Softwareentwicklung, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Fachgebiet an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule
Du verfügst über mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung mit C# und .NET/ASP.NET, inklusive EF Core, REST-APIs und relationalen Datenbanken
Du hast praktische Erfahrung im Frontend-Umfeld mit einem JavaScript-Framework, idealerweise Angular, und bringst vorteilhafte Kenntnisse in WPF mit
Du gehst sicher mit Git, GitHub sowie kollaborativen Entwicklungsprozessen und Workflows um
Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Azure Cloud Services, Azure DevOps CI/CD-Pipelines oder Docker
Du zeichnest dich durch starke Kommunikationsfaehigkeiten, Teamorientierung, eine selbststaendige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgepraegte analytische und loesungsorientierte Denkweise aus
